title: Fundamentals of Programming
content: CC2: Fundamentals of Programming COMPUTER PROGRAMMING Programming is just writing instructions that a computer follows. The computer is dumb. It does not think, it does not guess. It only does exactly what you tell it, in the exact order you tell it. Programming is you telling it what to do. Design -> Write -> Test -> Maintain. That's the whole job.
